scope: final-source real-weight reduced full path on P150x4: embedding, one sliding and one full-attention decoder layer, final norm, LM head, logits, split sampling, persistent decode state, and trace replay
comparison_method: sum of Device Time and Op-to-Op Gap for each signpost-isolated window; individual LM-head and sampler components use Device Time from the four-device-merged tt-perf-report CSV tables

selected.policy: one 65536-column local DRAM-interleaved BFP8 LM-head matmul per rank

candidate.policy: eight 8192-column DRAM-width-sharded BFP8 matmuls followed by eight sharded-to-interleaved conversions and concatenation

sampler_conclusion: The complete greedy vocabulary chain (TopkLargeIndicesDeviceOperation, both TopKDeviceOperation rows, and SamplingDeviceOperation) accounts for 351.678 us (15.055% of the selected reduced-path window). It does not dominate the 707.269 us LM head or the complete window. The measured production choice is the canonical generic sampler with force_argmax disabled; the separate sampler A/B artifact shows force-argmax is slower.
decision: retain the interleaved LM head: the candidate is 0.284% slower for split token-out, 0.518% slower for prefill, adds 191.25 MiB/device while retaining the base weight, and does not change the sampled tokens
